messages.subject: Problem with my N-Mixture model
parts:
Hi all,

I am stuckwith my n-mixture model for wolved from cameratrap data.


Of course it is a elusive species so, I get NAs in some of the sampling stations.

I am not getting succesful goodness of fit. I get some very weird outliers. As the one showed down here. I also get very high c-hat values, indicating data Overdispersion in P, NB but not in ZIP.


Also attached my “counts” data structure as an indicator of how much NAs are present.

I have tried with raw environmental data and with standardized environmental data, with similar results.


Can anyone tell what I could be doing wrong? Is there any particular treatment I should apply to NAs or stations with all zeros.


Thank you in advance. 



``` 
WolfCounts <- list(sites = sites,dates = dates,dur = dur,counts = counts)
y0 <- as.matrix(WolfCounts$counts[,-1])
dimnames(y0) <- list(sites = sites$Site, rep = colnames(WolfCounts$counts)[2:ncol(WolfCounts$counts)]) 

y <- y0

time <- matrix(rep(as.character(1:9), nrow(y)), ncol = 9, byrow = TRUE)
umf <- unmarkedFramePCount(y = y,
                           siteCovs=data.frame(elev=scale(sites[,"elevation"]), dist.wat=scale(sites[,"wat.dist"]),
                                              dist.pop=scale(sites[,"pop.dist"]), days= 1/(sites[,"days"])),
                           obsCovs=list(time = time, date = scale(date), dur = scale(dur)))

fm2 <- pcount(~ (elev + I(elev^2)) * (dist.pop + I(dist.pop^2)) + time-1 
              - I(dist.pop^2) 
              ~ (elev + I(elev^2)) * (dist.wat + I(dist.wat^2)) + days
              - I(elev^2):dist.wat,
              umf, control=list(trace=TRUE, REPORT=5, maxit = 300), K=800) 

fm2NB <- pcount(fm2@formula,
                umf, control=list(trace=TRUE, REPORT=5), K=1000, mixture = "NB”)

fm2ZIP <- pcount(fm2@formula,
                 umf, control=list(trace=TRUE, REPORT=5), K=800, mixture = "ZIP")


```
